title: Internship matching
content: InternSphere combines the signed-in user's saved profile with their latest parsed resume. It retrieves internships from the local internship knowledge base, calculates a semantic relevance score and separately calculates skill coverage from listed required and preferred skills. The overall ranking combines those values.

title: Resume upload and parsing
content: Users can upload PDF and DOCX resumes up to the configured upload limit. InternSphere extracts text, combines deterministic contact extraction with Gemini structured extraction, validates the result, and stores the parsed JSON with the authenticated user.

title: Profiles
content: Each authenticated user owns one private profile. A profile can store personal details, education, skills, links, and a profile picture. Manual profile data is retained alongside parsed resume data; matching combines both sources.

title: Applications
content: Users can apply to an internship once. Applications start with status Applied and can be tracked through Under Review, Shortlisted, Interview, Accepted, or Rejected. Withdrawing an application preserves its history and changes status to Withdrawn.

title: Cover letters
content: InternSphere can generate a cover letter using the authenticated candidate profile/resume and selected internship record. The generator is instructed to use only available candidate and internship facts. Users can edit the resulting letter before applying.

title: Security and authentication
content: Protected InternSphere actions require an access token from login. Tokens are signed with JWT_SECRET_KEY and expire after the configured time. If a server uses a new JWT secret, users must sign in again.
